resolution_rules._capital_pool_currency: Derives currency from explicit owner market (_explicit_market). For market-less requests, keeps str(requested or 'USD'). For explicit markets with settlement currency (US->USD, TW->TWD), defaults to settlement currency or validates requested currency matches settlement currency, failing closed with PersonaProvisioningCoordinationError on contradiction. For CRYPTO/FX without settlement currency, requires non-blank uppercase requested currency or fails closed. Rejects non-canonical or non-uppercase currency strings.
resolution_rules._coordinate_capital_pool: Computes currency = self._capital_pool_currency(record) before building base_payload; validates receipt.get('currency') == currency in readback validation.
resolution_rules._preview: Calls self._capital_pool_currency(record) so dry_run rejects contradictory, unresolvable, or malformed market/currency requests identically.
resolution_rules.transition_legacy_persona_market: Verifies checkpointed capital_pool receipt currency settles the target market (_MARKET_SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY) after paper universe symbols check and before acquiring lease.
